The structure of Na3SbF6 is cubic, space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with a 40-atom unit cell (Na12Sb4F24) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives octahedral Sb centers with six F neighbors at 2.012 Å, while Na centers show two environments: a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 F neighbors and a body-centered-cubic-like arrangement with 8 F neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Na and Sb polyhedra and face-sharing among Na polyhedra.
